about_the_game:
Stellar Howl - A Spacefaring Sokoban Adventure

Take on the role of a clever mechanical fox engineer in Stellar Howl, a fresh take on classic Sokoban-style puzzles set across collapsing space stations and alien planets. Master gravity-defying crate puzzles while using special engineering gadgets to overcome clever environmental challenges.

Core Features:

✔ Modern Sokoban Gameplay: The satisfying push-and-pull of classic block puzzles enhanced with space physics, multi-layered objectives, and interactive elements like gravity fields and teleporters.
✔ Engineering Tools: Expand your capabilities with a grappling hook for pulling objects, a dash booster for quick maneuvers, and a teleporter to swap places with crates.
✔ 50+ Handcrafted Puzzles: Progress through increasingly complex space stations and planetary outposts, each introducing new mechanics and surprises.
✔ Ship Upgrades & NPC Crew: Recruit quirky characters who provide new abilities and unlock hidden puzzle solutions.
✔ Charming Space Adventure: A lighthearted story about restoring order to the cosmos (with some chaotic fun along the way).

"A perfect blend of brain-teasing Sokoban challenges and space adventure charm!"

short_description: Play as a mechanical fox engineer in Stellar Howl, a Sokoban-inspired puzzle adventure set in a crumbling galaxy. Zoom between wobbly space stations and mysterious planets, where every crate you push and circuit you rewire brings the cosmos one step closer to working again(or causes hilarious chaos)
